questions.question: Correct the early-career and Moscow-premises chronology: the official profile dates Vinogradov’s professorship at Perm University from 1920, while the institute history places MIAN first at 19 Leninsky Prospekt and only later on Vavilov Street. The current wording “by the mid-1920s” and “a permanent base on Vavilov Street” is misleading. https://mi.ras.ru/index.php?c=inmemoriapage&id=26537 ; https://www.mi-ras.ru/index.php?c=about .
